description:
Free-text search within a single collection. Returns matching items decorated with a public `url`; total reflects what was found. Supports AND (default), OR, and "quoted phrases". Searches across the properties listed in the catalog below — other schema properties exist on objects but are not searchable here; use get_object for the full record or describe_collection to see every property. This tool does not filter by field value — use query_collection with `include`/`exclude` for that. Drafts are auto-hidden from anonymous callers.

Available collections and filterable properties:
- articles — id (id, sortable), title (text), author (select), summary (textarea), date (date, sortable), draft (toggle), updated (datetime, sortable)
- comparisons — competitor (text), competitorUrl (url), heading (text), lede (textarea), reviewed (date, sortable), draft (toggle), sort (number, sortable), id (id, sortable)
- extension — id (id, sortable), name (text), extensionId (text), soldAs (text), summary (textarea), category (select), price (number, sortable), currency (select), minEdition (select), minVersion (text), bundled (toggle), beta (toggle), docsUrl (url), productUrl (url), draft (toggle), owner (select), featured (toggle), approved (datetime, sortable), submitted (datetime, sortable), weight (range, sortable)
- guides — heading (text), lede (textarea), reviewed (date, sortable), draft (toggle), sort (number, sortable), id (id, sortable), kind (select), product (select)
- releases — id (id, sortable), version (text), title (text), date (date, sortable), draft (toggle), urgent (toggle), fullnotesurl (url), announce (toggle)
- showcase — name (text), url (url), industry (select), id (id, sortable), owner (select), draft (toggle), featured (toggle), approved (datetime, sortable), submitted (datetime, sortable), weight (range, sortable)

collection.description: Collection id to search within. Use list_collections to discover available collections.

format.description: Output format for styledtext properties on the matched items. markdown is friendliest for AI consumption.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (capped at 50 to fit MCP response-size budgets).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale tag. Accepted for forward-compat with the 3.6 i18n release — has no effect today.

query.description: Search terms. AND-semantics by default; use `or` between terms for OR; wrap phrases in double quotes.

name: search_collection

items.description: Matched objects, each a flat field map decorated with a `url`. Field set varies by collection.

url.description: Public URL when the collection has a URL pattern.
